about_blocks.text: About Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba In Beausejour
about_blocks.html: About Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba In Beausejour

about_blocks.text: Welcome to the Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba In Beausejour. Thank you for your interest in our organization. Being a foundation of excellence in delivering addiction services and promoting healthy behaviors, AFM is a Crown agency committed to its mission. A total of 400 people work at AFM, which operates in 28 locations throughout Manitoba and provides a variety of addictions services.

about_blocks.text: During their lifetime, at least 1 in 5 Canadians had difficulties with alcohol, medications, or gambling. When a person they love has these problems, it affects them in a big way. These problems affect people of all ages and ethnicities, and they make positive improvements.

about_blocks.text: AFM offers hope, support and change for people who are struggling with addictions.

about_blocks.text: Our addiction services include: rehabilitation, counselling and therapy, group programs, family support, peer support groups and more. We also provide resources such as information on addiction treatments available in Manitoba and how to get help.
